findings.title: Cron auth mismatch possible
findings.description: Vercel Cron can be configured to auto-inject the secret header, but the setup instructions should verify that the Vercel project environment variables are synchronized with the backend's CRON_SECRET. If they diverge, the Cron will fail with a 401 Unauthorized.

findings.title: Email service silently fails
findings.description: If SMTP configuration is incomplete or the provider is unreachable, the email service logs and swallows the error. The Cron job will report success even though no email was sent. Production must verify SMTP connectivity before deployment.

findings.title: Payment aggregation lacks period context
findings.description: The query sums all payments across all time periods. If a subscription spans multiple periods or payments are recorded out of order, the 'Reste à Encaisser' figure may be inaccurate. The calculation assumes one-to-one period mapping.

findings.title: Test endpoint exposes aggregated data
findings.description: The /test endpoint returns full report data in the HTTP response. This is useful for development but should not be exposed in production, or should require authentication beyond just the absence of a Cron header.

findings.title: Collectes restantes is redundant
findings.description: The field duplicates collectesEnAttente (both are SCHEDULED status counts). This matches the user's spec but adds no new information to the report; consider whether a separate 'remaining' metric was intended (e.g., total subscriptions minus collected ones).
